LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_Physician: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught while tending {OTHER}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_Physician_2: All those hours at {OTHER}'s bedside have left {PAWN_nameDef} with {ILLNESS} too. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_GuestCough: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught from {OTHER}, the guest with the cough. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_GuestCough_2: {OTHER} left a cough behind, and {PAWN_nameDef}, who sat with them longest, has {ILLNESS} now. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_ColdNight: A night in a cold bedroom under banked fires has given {PAWN_nameDef} {ILLNESS}, and the frail don't shake that off easily. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_ColdNight_2: {PAWN_nameDef} woke shivering after a bitter night with the fires banked low, and has {ILLNESS} now. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_Rut: {ANIMAL_nameDef}, in the rut, charged {PAWN_nameDef} in the pen and caught {PAWN_objective} on the {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_Rut_2: {PAWN_nameDef} went into the pen in the rut, and {ANIMAL_nameDef} lowered his head and charged.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_LessonKick: Learning the animals with {OTHER_nameDef}, {PAWN_nameDef} was kicked by a nervous {ANIMAL_labelShort}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_LessonKick_2: {ANIMAL_nameDef} took fright at the lesson and kicked out at {PAWN_nameDef}, while {OTHER_nameDef} calmed it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_LessonBite: Learning the animals with {OTHER_nameDef}, {PAWN_nameDef} was bitten by a nervous {ANIMAL_labelShort}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFour_LessonBite_2: {ANIMAL_nameDef} snapped at {PAWN_nameDef} during the lesson before {OTHER_nameDef} could calm it.

LanguageData.CC_Settings_DrinkBeforeHotWork_Tip: With Alpha Skills and a drink before work on: the drink may come before cooking and smithing too. Now and then (about one drink in a hundred before such work) it ends in a burn at the stove or the forge, or a cut from the knife. Off, a drink before work leaves the stove and the forge alone.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_DrinkBeforeHotWork: Before cooking and smithing too, with a small chance of a burn at the work.
